summary: Quote on NSE cash: the web test's MarketFeedV3 frame gives the full quote; a frame reporting 0 for LastRate keeps the last traded price while its quantities follow the frame.

notes: The second frame is FEED with LastRate 0, LastQty 0 and TotalQty 1300, as the web test sends it.
A MarketDepthService frame for the same scrip reaches no Quote subscriber on either side (test_depth_frame_is_not_published_to_quote_subscription).

deviations.reason: The 5paisa web adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (5paisa: the number).

The 5paisa web adapter passes 5paisa's JSON number on as it came, so a whole price (the web test's OpenRate 445) goes out as an integer (445) where the desktop sends a float (445.0). Same value, another JSON type: follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker number types (5paisa: a price keeps the type of the frame's value).

The web sends 5paisa's ChgPcnt as percent_change for every instrument; the desktop's common carrier sends the change fields for indices only, so an equity or a future loses it. Carrier gap (change fields for every exchange, audit C04, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best bid (BidRate); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best bid quantity (BidQty); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best ask (OffRate); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best ask quantity (OffQty); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
